setup: Empty working directory, no repository. The grader plays the human and answers from fixtures/persona-meal-planner.md.
query: My family keeps arguing about what to cook. I want something where we plan the week's dinners together. Can you help me write up what it should do?
expected_behavior: Asks about actors, then goals, then proposes milestones, before any EARS line
Writes roadmap.md with M1 as the smallest release that lets the family agree on a week, sign-in in M1, and Supabase absent from it
Asks at most three questions per round, each a concrete story with outcomes to pick from
Details only M1: walks edges for voting (ties, repeated votes, taking a vote back) and for the locked week
Turns 'feel quick' into a line with the 5-second number after asking for one
Keeps Supabase under Not expectations and writes no line that names it
Saves the roadmap and a draft brief as the interview goes
Shows the whole brief and waits for approval before the final write
Writes brief-m1.md with 'Reconciled with: none' and 'Milestone: M1', within 3 features and 25 lines
Runs check-brief.mjs on the roadmap and on the brief without --draft, and both pass
Tells the human to hand the roadmap and the brief to an nnn-mode session
must_not: Choose a stack, design screens or a schema, or write code
Write a line the human did not approve

setup: Working directory is the repository produced by a passing run of the building-from-expectations eval bootstrap-new-product, committed. The grader answers from fixtures/persona-search.md.
query: Add search to our todo app. It has to be fast, show relevant results, and use Elasticsearch.
expected_behavior: Reads docs/glossary.md and the existing expectation files before drafting
Proposes a number for 'fast' and asks the human to confirm it
Asks what makes a todo relevant, with a concrete proposal
Asks what Elasticsearch is meant to guarantee, and keeps it only under Not expectations
Uses the glossary's word for a todo in every line
Puts the lines under an existing todos feature with its prefix, or a new search feature with a prefix that no feature uses
Writes the current commit after 'Reconciled with:'
Runs check-brief.mjs with --repo and it passes
must_not: Edit any file in the repository other than the new brief

setup: Working directory is the repository produced by bootstrap-new-product, committed. The grader answers from fixtures/persona-change.md.
query: Some changes for the todo app: the done list should show 100 instead of 50, each person gets their own list instead of one shared list, and new todos should still go on top.
expected_behavior: Writes 'Replace' for the 50-item limit expectation, keeping its ID
Points out that per-person lists contradict the shared-list expectation and asks before writing it as a Replace or Withdraw
Asks how the product tells people apart, since there is no sign-in yet
Asks what happens to the existing shared todos
Tells the human that 'new todos go on top' is already covered, names the ID, and leaves it out of the brief
Runs check-brief.mjs with --repo and it passes
must_not: Renumber or restate an existing line outside a Replace
Edit expectation files or the lock file in the repository

setup: Empty working directory. The grader answers from fixtures/persona-tutors.md.
query: I want to build a tutoring marketplace. Students search tutors by subject and price, book lessons, pay in the app, chat with tutors, leave reviews. Tutors manage profiles and calendars synced with Google Calendar. Admins approve tutors and handle refunds. Referral rewards, an analytics dashboard, and iOS and Android apps too. Help me write it all up for the builder.
expected_behavior: Writes a roadmap before any EARS line, and asks the human to approve its milestone order
Makes M1 the smallest release in which a student finds an approved tutor and books a first lesson, with sign-in and tutor approval in M1
Puts payments, reviews, and chat in later milestones in the human's order, and the rest under Later, as one-line goals
Writes EARS lines only for M1
Keeps each brief within 3 features and 25 lines, splitting M1 into brief-m1-1.md and brief-m1-2.md in dependency order if needed
Keeps Next.js under Not expectations
Runs check-brief.mjs on the roadmap and on every brief, and they pass
must_not: Write EARS lines for payments, chat, reviews, or any later milestone
Produce one brief with more than 3 features or 25 lines

setup: Working directory holds fixtures/resume/roadmap.md and fixtures/resume/brief-m1.md, a draft from an earlier session. The grader answers from fixtures/persona-resume.md.
query: Let's continue the dinner planner brief.
expected_behavior: Reads the roadmap and the draft brief before asking anything
Asks the two open questions first, with a proposed answer for each
Covers the M1 goals the draft doesn't cover yet, such as locking the week, without re-asking what the draft settles
Adds the answers as EARS lines, sets Open questions to None., and gets approval for the whole brief
Runs check-brief.mjs without --draft and it passes
must_not: Ask again about the sign-in link, the 5-second limit, or voting that the draft already settles
Rewrite approved lines without the human asking

setup: Working directory is the repository produced by bootstrap-new-product, committed. The host has web search. The grader answers from fixtures/persona-recurring.md.
query: We want todos that repeat. Can you write up the lines?
expected_behavior: Looks up how several products handle repeating tasks, and which standards apply, before walking the edges
Brings findings into the rounds as proposed answers with sources, such as asking whether an edit applies to one occurrence, the following ones, or all
Proposes an answer for a monthly todo made on the 31st, with the reason
Writes only approved lines into the brief, with no research text in it

setup: Empty working directory, no repository. The grader plays a non-technical human and answers from fixtures/persona-booking-states.md.
query: I want an app where students find a tutor and book a first lesson. Tutors sign up, and I check them before students can see them. A student picks a free hour from the tutor's week and sends a request. The tutor says yes or no within a day, otherwise it just drops. Later we'll add payments. Can you write up what it should do?
expected_behavior: Finds the states of the tutor, the hour, and the lesson request from the human's words, including dropped
Adds endings the human didn't name, such as a request taken back and a booked lesson cancelled, and asks about them
Asks, as a story with named people, what happens when two students want the same hour before the tutor answers
Asks, as a story, what happens when the tutor's day to answer runs past the lesson's start time
Asks what happens to waiting requests and booked lessons when the owner hides a tutor
Draws the request's states, including dropped and cancelled, in the review chart
Proposes a standard word such as 'expired' for 'drops', with a reason, and uses the picked word in every line
Writes approved lines for each of these answers in brief-m1.md
must_not: Ask the human to list states or statuses, or use the words 'state machine' or 'status field' with the human
Write a line the human did not approve
